articles.headline: Guardiola 'embarrassed' to say no to Italy, national team my 'next step'
articles.description: Pep Guardiola said he felt "embarrassed" to turn down the head coaching position with Italy, but added he could return to coaching in the future and, if he did, would like to do it with a national team.

articles.headline: Leaked FIFA documents show 96-year plan for stakes in WC sell-off
articles.description: Gianni Infantino's failed private equity plan that started the biggest crisis of his FIFA presidency intended to sell stakes in the FIFA World Cup for 96 years.

articles.headline: Messi tracker: Goals, assists, key moments in 2026
articles.description: ESPN provides game-by-game analysis of Lionel Messi's performances for Inter Miami and Argentina.

articles.headline: CONMEBOL backs Infantino's reelection as FIFA president
articles.description: Support for the reelection of FIFA president Gianni Infantino was reaffirmed by the 10 members of CONMEBOL on Friday.

articles.headline: Harry Kane sets sights on Champions League, England trophy after Ballon d'Or win
articles.description: Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane is on a mission to claim trophies that have so far eluded him in his career, namely a Champions League and a tittle with England.

articles.headline: Infantino calls for 'fair play' in upcoming FIFA elections
articles.description: Gianni Infantino has called for "fair play" during the election campaign for the FIFA presidency.
